result_class: B (evaluated model). Never evidence, never a verdict: it ranks text, not physical applicability.
what_it_is: What a standard open-source embedding search would retrieve for the same question as the web app's TF-IDF panel.

model.name: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5
model.onnx_source: Hugging Face repo Qdrant/bge-small-en-v1.5-onnx-Q (int8-quantized ONNX build of the model, as fastembed ships it)
model.runtime: fastembed (ONNX); documents and queries embedded with the same call, no query instruction prefix
model.note: Texts longer than the model's limit are truncated by the tokenizer.

documents.text: acronym + title + objective + approach from the PSI record JSON + titles of the publications PSI lists (data/manifest/publications.csv)

queries.iss-cabin-air: The nominal ISS cabin atmosphere, 14.7 psia with 21% O2, in microgravity. microgravity, liquid fuel, N₂ diluent
queries.challenge-lunar-base: The challenge states the Moon Base atmosphere as a band: 30% O2 or more at 10.2 psi or less. This preset is the corner of that band (30% O2, 10.2 psi) at lunar gravity. partial gravity, liquid fuel, N₂ diluent
queries.nesc-10.2psia-26.5o2-lunar: One of the two Exploration Atmospheres assessed by the NASA Engineering and Safety Center, paired with lunar gravity because the report considers them for surface habitats. partial gravity, liquid fuel, N₂ diluent
queries.nesc-8.2psia-34o2-lunar: The second NESC Exploration Atmosphere, paired with lunar gravity for the same reason. The report also considers O2 up to 40% at 8.2 psia when assessing flammability. partial gravity, liquid fuel, N₂ diluent

query_source: web/components/Explorer.tsx:299: `${preset.description} ${targetRegimeName(regime)}` with the app's starting regime (liquid fuel, N2 diluent) and the preset's gravity regime.
